name: Console New Tab
tagline: A New Tab page like a console: a monospace field behind a > prompt, Recently Closed, and every chat as a line.
description: The New Tab page cmux once shipped as its Console template, rebuilt as a cmux.newtab/1 app from public surfaces only: a monospace field behind a > prompt, the tabs you closed last, and every chat (Chats or Projects, a filter, a search), newest first. Remove it and your own New Tab page comes back.
